programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: DNA Of A Murder: Andrew George
programmes.d: Hilda Murrell, a 78-year-old distinguished rose-grower, was found dead in woodland near her home town. Despite a huge investigation by the British police, detectives failed to find her killer and conspiracy theories muddied the waters still further.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: The Body In The Suitcase: Lorenzo Simon
programmes.d: On 12th May 2014 a human torso was discovered in a suitcase during routine maintenance work on a Birmingham canal. With no useable DNA and no other body parts, the case initially seemed impossible to crack.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Bodies Of Evidence: Roger Severs
programmes.d: In November 1993, Derek and Eileen Severs disappeared without a word. When police spoke to their son, Roger, he insisted they were on holiday. However, there was no evidence of this apparent trip, and Roger was soon arrested on suspicion of murder.

programmes.t: Killer Britain
programmes.d: James Fairweather was a 15-year-old boy obsessed with serial killers, violent video games and extreme pornography. He stabbed two strangers to death in separate attacks. He was found unanimously guilty by a jury on 22 April 2016.

programmes.t: Killer Britain
programmes.d: Sana Muhammad, formerly known as Devi, had left her unhappy arranged marriage to Ramanodge Unmathallegadoo and remarried. She was a pregnant mother of five when he murdered her in her home.

programmes.t: Killer Britain
programmes.d: Stephen Port was convicted of the assaults, rapes and murders of Anthony Walgate, Gabriel Kovari, Daniel Whitworth and Jack Taylor. He was sentenced to life imprisonment with a whole life order.

programmes.t: Killer Britain
programmes.d: A gangland feud brings years of murder and mayhem into an inner-city community. Journalist Dermot Murnaghan and detective Clive Driscoll delve into the shocking story of Mark Fellows, and the persistence and ingenuity that brought the feud to an end.

programmes.t: Killer Britain
programmes.d: Dermot Murnaghan remembers the morning of 2 June 2010 when the news broke of a gunman on the loose in Cumbria, indiscriminately killing strangers. Along with former Met detective Clive Driscoll, Dermot looks back on the remarkable events of that day.

programmes.t: Killer Britain
programmes.d: Dermot Murnaghan brings in the homicide expertise of top detective Clive Driscoll to explore the investigation into the death of pharmacist Jessica Patel. Her husband Mitesh claims it’s a burglary gone wrong, but the evidence paints the real story.

programmes.t: Killer Britain
programmes.d: Dermot Murnaghan looks back on the disturbing tale of how a sadistic game played by Isabella Gossling and her boyfriend Richard Moors resulted in the death of an innocent young man.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Manchester
programmes.d: The series returns to take a closer look at the most horrific crimes ever committed on British soil, starting with the May 2017 Manchester Arena bombing.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Ann Maguire
programmes.d: The tragic story of Ann Maguire, who was stabbed to death by a teenage pupil while teaching a Spanish lesson at Corpus Christi Catholic College in Leeds.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Gemma McCluskie
programmes.d: The harrowing story of EastEnders actress Gemma McCluskie, who was murdered by her older brother in the flat they shared in east London in 2012.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Stepping Hill
programmes.d: An inside look at the series of mysterious deaths that occurred at Stepping Hill Hospital in Stockport, Greater Manchester, in 2011.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Steven Wright
programmes.d: A closer look at the crimes of Steve Wright, who was dubbed 'The Suffolk Strangler' after murdering five women who worked as prostitutes in Ipswich in 2006.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Appointment With Death: Scott Singleton
programmes.d: Robbie Coltrane examines the case of Scott Singleton, who murdered a 17-year-old girl after luring her to a bogus job interview.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Countryside Killings: Graham Backhouse
programmes.d: Robbie Coltrane examines why Graham Backhouse attempted to kill his wife with a car bomb before murdering his neighbour in 1984.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Far From Home: Kyu Soo Kim
programmes.d: Robbie Coltrane examines the harrowing case of a London landlord who sadistically tortured and murdered two of his tenants.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: The Saturday Night Strangler: Joe Kappen
programmes.d: In 1973, three young girls were beaten, raped and strangled over a six-week period. The Saturday Night Strangler escaped justice for almost 30 years. But new techniques in DNA technology and a midnight exhumation finally uncovered the killer.
